nodes.label: Full invoice must contain core seller/buyer/date/number/content fields
nodes.norm_label: full invoice must contain core seller/buyer/date/number/content fields

nodes.label: Issued invoices must be stored immutably with sequential invoice numbers
nodes.norm_label: issued invoices must be stored immutably with sequential invoice numbers
nodes.rationale: Rentemester must only issue invoices after deterministic validation and must persist an immutable issued snapshot tied to a sequential invoice number; when the invoice currency is not DKK, the snapshot must include the chosen FX rate and DKK totals fixed at issue time.

nodes.label: Issued invoices cannot be modified
nodes.rationale: Corrections to issued invoices are handled via credit note and new invoice, not mutation.

nodes.label: Invoice payments must be traceably applied against issued invoices and bank transactions
nodes.norm_label: invoice payments must be traceably applied against issued invoices and bank transactions
nodes.rationale: Rentemester must track which issued invoice a payment settles, how much was applied, and whether any balance remains open.

nodes.label: Invoice preview must render the issued-invoice PDF without mutating the ledger
nodes.norm_label: invoice preview must render the issued-invoice pdf without mutating the ledger
nodes.rationale: Rentemester's "Forhåndsvis"-flow (#440) must run the same validator + renderer as the irreversible issue path so the owner sees the exact PDF the customer will receive, but without drawing a fortløbende invoice number, without writing a documents row, and without appending to audit_log — a closed preview must leave the ledger and sequence-serie untouched.

nodes.label: Simplified invoice is only allowed up to DKK 3,000 gross and needs the reduced field set
nodes.norm_label: simplified invoice is only allowed up to dkk 3,000 gross and needs the reduced field set

nodes.label: Recurring invoice generation is explicit, deterministic and idempotent per template period
nodes.norm_label: recurring invoice generation is explicit, deterministic and idempotent per template period
nodes.rationale: Rentemester materialises a recurring invoice only on an explicit generate call for a given as-of date; the issue date and delivery period are derived deterministically from the template's first issue date and interval, and a unique template/period audit link prevents duplicate generation across reruns.

nodes.label: Emailing an invoice or reminder must be deterministic, idempotent, and recorded in an append-only send log
nodes.norm_label: emailing an invoice or reminder must be deterministic, idempotent, and recorded in an append-only send log
nodes.rationale: Rentemester may email an issued invoice or a payment reminder to the customer with the rendered PDF attached, but only deterministically and idempotently. The MIME message and its message-id must be fully derived from the content so an identical send collapses onto the existing append-only send-log row instead of silently re-transmitting. A send is recorded in the send log (recipient, document, message-id, timestamp) and audit-linked; a transport failure writes no success row. SMTP credentials and SMTP configuration stay outside core bookkeeping state — they are sourced from a config file or environment, never persisted to the ledger. The send must fail clearly on a missing customer email or missing SMTP config.
